name: 7.5.Verify Page redirections for Used Implements Product Detail Pages
fullName: 7.5.Verify Page redirections for Used Implements Product Detail Pages
description:
Verify that the Used Implement product detail page (Mahindra Cutter Thresher, Rajasthan) (used-implement/mahindra/cutter-thresar-rajasthan/5915/) loads successfully and every in-page link (outside the shared header/footer nav) resolves without a 404 or 500 error, with correct trailing slashes on internal links.

Expected: The Used Implement product detail page (Mahindra Cutter Thresher, Rajasthan) should load successfully (HTTP 200) and every in-page link in scope should resolve to a valid destination — no broken (404) or server-error (500) links, and internal links should end with a trailing slash.
